reviews.text:
I took my Doberman to the Castelverde Dog Center, and I must say it was a truly positive experience. Anyone familiar with this breed knows how important it is to find trained people who can properly handle a strong, intelligent, and lively dog.

I'm very satisfied and would definitely recommend the Castelverde Dog Center to anyone looking for expertise, professionalism, and a caring approach to their dog's well-being.
Thank you so much ♥️ to all the staff

100% availability, so much care and attention for my dog ​​and for me too. They take the worry out of knowing how your four-legged friend is doing by sending you videos and messages every day throughout her stay. When I picked my dog ​​up, she had no intestinal problems and I found her happy and content. It's very important to me to not have to worry about knowing how she is doing while I'm away. Thanks to Francesca and all her staff. Super attentive and helpful ❤️ thanks also from Havana 🐾
What can I say? Simply fantastic. You can see that they are people who do their job with passion... if I could I would give more than 5 stars... Congratulations, keep it up...

We brought our American Bully XL puppy for her first experience and we were thrilled. Francesca and the girls who work with her are very professional, you can see the passion they have, dedicating themselves to the care of the dogs and especially the owners :-) sending videos several times a day!! We were very satisfied and calm throughout the holiday, seeing that she was well and having the peace of mind of competent people, who constantly updated us. A heartfelt thank you!!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

Our dog has been cared for at this center since he was a puppy. We started with obedience training and then moved on to agility and swimming. We've always had a great experience: great professionalism, expertise, and attention to detail. Highly recommended!

We left our puppy Amélie at a boarding facility here during our vacation, and we couldn't have made a better choice. Everyone was super kind and helpful, and they made us feel incredibly at ease, thanks in part to the videos they sent us twice a day, allowing us to see her and see how she was doing. This was truly important to us, as it was the first time we'd left her for so many days.
We also took advantage of the Taxi Dog service, and Tania was incredible: so sweet, patient, and incredibly understanding, especially considering that Amélie isn't particularly fond of car rides...
The best thing was knowing that Amélie was happy and had made so many four-legged friends! Thank you so much to all the staff for taking such good care of her and for making our vacation so much more stress-free!
A well-maintained facility, with knowledgeable and always available staff. Especially Sara, who is excellent with both dogs and people.

Simply impeccable daycare and boarding service! Leaving your dog here means having complete confidence that he's in safe hands, loved, and cared for with the utmost professionalism.
The facility is large, surrounded by greenery, clean, and securely fenced. The outdoor spaces are fantastic for playing and socializing. During the daycare stay (and during the daycare), the staff's attention to the dogs' physical and emotional well-being is constant. It's immediately obvious that the staff works with true passion and deep behavioral expertise, and not just as a "storage facility."
Coming back for Kuma and seeing him happy, calm, and well-stimulated is priceless. An exceptional and highly trusted place to stay in Eastern Rome. Highly recommended!

When I travel abroad, I always take my Owen to this dog training center, which also offers boarding services. The facilities are well-maintained and clean, the staff are kind and knowledgeable, and always attentive to the dogs' well-being. They sent us videos every day. This year, my return flight was canceled twice, and the staff were incredibly kind and kept our cocker spaniel for us beyond our booked stay: they saved our vacation! Another highlight is the recently added grooming service, which is incredibly convenient for picking up our dog clean and smelling fresh after days of exercise. One of the best groomings my Owen has ever had! Congratulations to everyone, you are always a guarantee.

A paradise for my furry friend.
My Yuki is a wary and unsociable dog; he struggles with people outside his family.
The first time I spoke to them, they left me with a feeling of peace, which was further confirmed when I dropped off my little Maremma dog at their boarding house.
They are passionate, kind, and give your friend time. Yuki, besides being a regular here, has made many new human friends.
They even managed to groom him!
5 stars only because I couldn't give them more; they're amazing!

We left our Smeagol two weeks ago to go away for a few days. The place is beautiful, well-kept, and well-organized. They sent me videos of my puppy every morning and evening to reassure me, which was really nice 🥰 I got my dog ​​back feeling calm; he had fun, ran, and played with other dogs. I'm very satisfied with the stay, not to mention the price, which, for the service offered, is more than fair. I will be back for future needs. Highly recommended!
All super fantastic we left with them two cats and a dog they are great... thanks guys....

We started a training course with our dachshund, Ruben, and we're thrilled to have chosen the Castelverde Dog Training Center. The trainers, in our case Sara, are extremely knowledgeable and attentive to the needs of the dog and its owner. In no time, Ruben seemed like a different dog.
Thanks so much to the entire team.

A special experience.
I've been bringing my puppy Diana, a Rottweiler, to this wonderful dog training center for about a month. From our first meeting, the trainer, Francesca, proved to be professional and passionate about her work and her furry friends. Thanks to her methods, we immediately noticed excellent results in our puppy. We'll continue coming from September, applying all her valuable advice in August.
I recommend them to anyone with a four-legged friend. They're well-mannered, professional, and full of love and passion.
We left our furry friend with competent and caring people for a long weekend. Receiving his videos twice a day immediately reassured us.

I took my Staffordshire Bull Terrier to the Castelverde dog training center for the first time, where he stayed for just over a week. Every morning and afternoon, videos were punctual, and my dog ​​was always cheerful, happy, and content!
What can I say? The entire staff is excellent, very knowledgeable, and there's plenty of space for our four-legged friends, easy to get to.
The center also offers many activities.
I've finally found a boarding facility where I can feel at peace and carefree, leaving my Phoenix in safe and reliable hands!
I brought my little dog, I was very worried because I had never left him, I had a great time, photos and videos to see him continuously and I even saw my Luffy having fun.

We take our two dachshunds, Wudy and Ipa, to the Castelverde Dog Center every time we have to go away for work on the weekend, and it's become a guarantee for us.

Knowing we're leaving them in a place where they're cared for with care, professionalism, and lots of love allows us to always leave with peace of mind. We always find them in excellent condition, and we can be sure they're receiving all the care and attention they need during their stay.

One thing we really appreciate is that they send us video updates every morning and evening. It's truly wonderful to be able to watch Wudy and Ipa running free on the lawn, playing, and moving about at ease: it's a kindness that makes us feel involved and allows us to enjoy their stay with much greater peace of mind.

We also really appreciated the opportunity to let them spend an hour in the pool. It's a service not all kennels offer, and we found it truly interesting, an added value that demonstrates the care and attention dedicated to the dogs' well-being.

The staff is always available, competent, and exudes a great passion for their work. The facility is well-organized, clean, and offers a safe and well-maintained environment.

We highly recommend the Castelverde Dog Center!

Very knowledgeable and friendly staff, and plenty of parking. The green areas where training takes place are very large, and sometimes multiple dogs are trained at once. There's a café, leashes and muzzles for sale, and dog grooming.

I started a training program with my 6-year-old dog, convinced I couldn't improve her fearful nature and the lack of attention she paid me when I called her back. But I definitely have to change my mind. Now, after just a few lessons, Mia listens to me more, when I call her back, when I walk her, and most importantly, she didn't like "female dogs," and thanks to them, she's now calmer when they come up to her to sniff her. They're a truly beautiful team to watch, friendly, with a lot of professionalism, love for dogs, tenacity, and skill. They make you feel at ease, like you're at home, both for me and my dog. Now, every time we go to their place, Mia is happier! Thank you, thank you ❤️

I'm Kira's mom and I'm happy to have brought her to this center. Friendly and well-trained staff, very professional, and plenty of greenery for our puppies who are always indoors. I went on vacation feeling peaceful and relaxed, knowing that my dog ​​was just as happy. Fair prices and very professional ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
My princess had a great time, the place was clean, well-equipped, spacious and with very professional staff.

Well done!! The center is a wonderful place, surrounded by greenery, welcoming and well-organized, and the entire staff is extremely kind and professional.

We are cared for by Francesca and couldn't have asked for better. She is highly competent, and you can immediately sense how passionate she is about her work and how much love she puts into it. She is precise, clear in her explanations, and instantly puts you at ease.

Thanks to her, we have learned to better understand our dog's language and handle many situations with greater awareness. Her advice is always practical, and from the very first lessons, we have seen wonderful progress.

We recommend this center to anyone looking to embark on a serious journey, guided by truly knowledgeable, passionate people with an immense love for animals!

The center is perfect; there are so many activities you can do with your dog. I'm taking classes with the legendary Francesca, a fantastic person. I've quickly achieved the desired results; my dog ​​goes for walks without any anxiety or socialization issues. I highly recommend it if you're looking for a serious and reliable place.

We've been attending the dog training center with our beagle for almost a year. Thanks to the training course, we've seen great progress, despite Pablo's lively temperament.
The staff has proven to be knowledgeable, helpful, and always welcoming. This is why Pablo continues to enthusiastically attend both the daycare and boarding facilities.
We highly recommend this center: Pablo can't wait to arrive!

A very well-maintained and efficient dog training center.
The qualified and professional staff are extremely dedicated to our furry friends.
I am grateful to all the staff for helping Akita and Kanji have a unique experience.
Their peace of mind and our peace of mind.
The Castelverde dog training center is what gives us the peace of mind of leaving them in the care of professionals.
Thank you all, well done, with love.
Gianfranco Pucci

I'm feeling great and couldn't be more satisfied with the journey we're on.

My puppy, now 4 months old, was initially scared of everything: every loud noise terrified her, and she always tried to slip out of her harness. Thanks to them, in just a few sessions, we were able to get her to do her business outside and turn walks into enjoyable experiences, both for her and for us. Today, she's much more eager to go out, and the progress is truly visible. We even managed to completely eliminate her pads in just a few days.

I'm following the program primarily with Francesca, who is extremely helpful, sweet, and knowledgeable. She immediately puts you at ease and guides you step by step, without ever making you feel judged.

The sessions are always interesting, engaging, and even fun. In addition to practical exercises, they clearly explain dog language and their real needs, helping you truly understand your four-legged companion.

Being my first dog, I initially experienced a lot of stress, the classic "puppy blues." Thanks to their support, I was able to overcome it, regain serenity, and truly enjoy my time with her. Today, we have a much more balanced relationship, and every day it's a pleasure to share this experience together.

I wholeheartedly recommend this center to anyone who wants to learn to understand their dog and build a peaceful, trusting relationship with them.

I attend this dog training center with my 8-month-old poodle, Artù, and I'm having a great time. From the first moment, I was impressed by the attention to detail, the professionalism of the staff, and the welcoming, family-like atmosphere.
The program is engaging, well-organized, and stimulating: each lesson offers new activities, games, and experiences that allow both dog and owner to learn and grow together. Over the past few months, I've seen Artù make great progress thanks to his experiences at the center and the valuable advice he's received.
One of the aspects I've most appreciated is the atmosphere: there's great inclusion and respect for everyone, regardless of the dog's age, breed, or personality. Every pair is welcomed and valued, creating a peaceful and stimulating environment. I've had the pleasure of meeting so many people with the same passion for dogs and sharing fun moments even outside of class.
I highly recommend this center to anyone who wants to embark on a journey of growth, education, and fun with their dog, relying on competent and passionate professionals.

Since January, Simba and I have been going to the center to take lessons with Elisa, who is very good and always available, super good and with the desire to make us start a journey even though Simba is already an adult dog (which not everyone does!)... when necessary I leave Simba in the boarding house and he is always happy, they update you morning and evening with videos and the dogs have plenty of space to move and be calm 😁

We entrusted our poodle to this dog boarding facility and the experience was very positive. From the very beginning, we found the staff to be extremely professional and helpful.
During her entire stay, we received daily videos, both morning and evening, allowing us to constantly monitor her well-being and happiness.
Our dog was cared for with care and attention and returned home feeling calm and in excellent condition.
We are completely satisfied with the service we received and would recommend this boarding facility to anyone looking for a reliable environment for their pet.

We bring our little dog here for training with Elisa. She's always available and excellent!
We even left our Brown dog here for boarding for a short time while we were away, what can I say?
These guys are so sweet and attentive, especially to the daily care our dog receives. Every day they send us videos of how he's doing... they even offer grooming service so you can pick him up smelling fresh and clean!
A guarantee!!! 🫶🏻

We're attending this dog training center for our dog and couldn't be more satisfied. The trainers are extremely knowledgeable and patient (especially with us!!!). In just a few lessons, we've seen incredible improvements and, most importantly, we've learned to communicate better with our dog. A special thanks to Francesca. Highly recommended!

I discovered Francesca and the dog training center on the recommendation of the trainer who initially looked after us with our puppy Olly. Soon after, I discovered that several friends and family had already entrusted themselves to her with success!
The center offers many services and courses that we will certainly be taking advantage of very soon.
​So far, I'm truly enthusiastic about the journey we're on together. I trust and rely completely on Francesca. The love, passion, utmost dedication, and professionalism she puts into her work are clearly evident. By following her instructions, I feel calm, confident, and in good hands. 🍀
Highly recommended!
Congratulations, you guys are amazing. Francesca, you're amazing ❤️
Thank you guys for your dedication and professionalism. Francesca is an excellent, dedicated, and professional person. Thank you so much.

I'll start by saying that I've never been consistent with things.
I started because I was having management issues with my Kira. And I have to say that even though x has a lot of work to do, I feel much more confident and know how to manage.
I started to understand her... I'm improving too...
And that's not to be underestimated at all.
Dog training center managed by professional and helpful staff.
Optimal
Expertise, kindness, and professionalism make this fantastic team a guarantee. A special shout-out to my Francesca!

I took my pug to the Castelverde Dog Center and was very worried because it was the first time I'd left him. Now I can say I couldn't have made a better choice. The staff were great! Twice a day they sent me videos, and I could see how happy my pug was playing. I'll definitely leave him with them when I need him!
Very good, very kind, super helpful… every day they sent me the video to show me my plague. A wonderful discovery!!!
Very well prepared guys
I brought my puppy Bea to the center because she always pulled during walks and didn't obey me. Thanks to Sara, we managed to train her and now going out with her is a pleasure.

I'm taking the ENCI training course at this dog training center, and I can say it's one of the most wonderful and interesting experiences I've had so far. I thought I knew dogs, but this program, along with Francesca, Lorenzo, and Gigi, has truly opened up a whole new world to me, helping me understand and see so many things I'd never seen before.
I highly recommend this dog training center to anyone who loves dogs and wants to learn to better understand them and build a peaceful and nurturing relationship with them. Furthermore, the center also offers a clean dog kennel that's well-managed by the staff.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone; your passion for animals shines through in every lesson and makes this program even more special!

Highly recommended dog training center. Plenty of space, meticulously maintained, and above all, CLEAN. The technicians are all competent, professional, empathetic, and helpful. You can tell they love what they do, and in addition to caring for and loving the animals, they also welcome and make the owners feel at ease.
If they had one, I'd also give more stars for the kiosk inside the center, where you can't miss the post-training beer 🤣
Highly recommended

Extremely satisfied with the experience at the Castel Verde Dog Center! The staff is helpful, professional, and always available. They help you truly understand your dog and become their go-to person. Highly recommended!

I've been bringing my dog ​​here for a few months and I couldn't have made a better choice.
The staff is highly trained, patient, and truly passionate. They immediately understood my dog's personality, and we've made tremendous progress, both in basic training and leash management.
The environment is clean, safe, and peaceful.
You can tell the dog's well-being comes first. Highly recommended to anyone looking for professionalism and compassion. ❤️

I've been attending the Castelverde Dog Center with my dog ​​Maya for about a year, and I can honestly say it's become a fundamental point of reference for both me and her.

From day one, I've found an extremely professional and welcoming environment, run by people who work with great expertise, passion, and, above all, a true love for dogs. The trainers are highly trained, patient, helpful, and always ready to explain everything with kindness and care, putting both dog and owner at ease.

The boarding service is also impeccable: knowing I'm leaving Maya in such trustworthy hands gives me enormous peace of mind. You can clearly see how much the entire staff cares about the animals' well-being and how seriously and dedicated they work every single day.

Today I also attended the expert dog handler course, and it was a truly wonderful, educational, and engaging experience in every way. I learned so much and was once again confirmed in the center's extremely high professional standards. Thank you, Francesca 🔝

I recommend the Castelverde Dog Center to anyone looking for quality, expertise, compassion, and a dedicated environment where dogs are cared for with care and respect. My sincere congratulations to the entire staff for the exceptional work you do every day!

I've known Francesca, the owner, for 10 years now. We started a training program with my second Pitbull (who others considered unruly!)... after just 3 lessons, he's already made changes I wasn't expecting! With 3 locations, they're truly available everywhere! Highly recommended!

Beautiful, welcoming and above all professional dog training center. With their work and my dedication to training, my dog ​​has completely changed for the better. The people are always available for help and questions. Very kind. Highly recommended. 💪🏻💥 …

Calling it a dog training center would be an understatement. When I go, I feel like I'm at a dog sports club. In addition to the expertise, I find sharing, fun, a refreshment stand while I wait for my dog ​​Cali to be groomed, a walking area, a great desire to do things with my dog... many other services I haven't used yet, such as dog and cat boarding, but from the premise, I would happily leave my pets there.
Excellent dog training center: highly trained instructors, a safe environment, and truly effective training. My dog ​​has improved tremendously! Highly recommended.

A true paradise for our four-legged friends! It's not just a training center, but a big family. I highly recommend this dog training center to anyone who wants to improve their relationship with their dog. The technicians are extremely competent, professional, and above all, friendly. I also want to give a shout-out to the cafe/kiosk located in the center; the guy who works there is extremely helpful and kind.
5 well-deserved stars

I'm completely satisfied with the journey I'm taking with my dog ​​Coco. I'm being cared for by Francesca and her team. From the very first meeting, Francesca managed to correct some of my dog's behaviors. I highly recommend this center.

Francesca and her center have always been a guarantee... we've been away from Rome for a few years now, but the Castelverde dog training center remains our go-to place when we're in the area. Our puppies have attended her classes and have often stayed at her kennel.
It was a pleasure to return to a place that's increasingly packed with activities, with the same kindness, professionalism, and friendliness as always... I highly recommend it.

I brought my dog ​​Charlie to the Castelverde Dog Center and couldn't be happier with my choice. From the very beginning, I felt a serious yet calm atmosphere, where the dog's well-being truly comes first.
I'm cared for by Francesca, and she really makes a difference: she's extremely knowledgeable, patient, and always available. She explains everything clearly, puts you at ease, and always works with full respect for the dog and his pace.
With Charlie, I saw tangible improvements after just a few lessons, and even more importantly, I learned to understand and manage him better. It's not just training, it's a true journey we share.
There's great attention to every detail, and you never feel left alone.

I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to embark on a serious journey with their dog, trusting in competent people who truly love what they do.

A truly positive experience! I took my Chihuahua Max to this dog training center, and the results were immediately visible. Francesca, the owner, is very knowledgeable, professional, and has extensive experience in the field. She knows how to put both dogs and owners at ease, explaining everything clearly and expertly.
The staff also deserves a lot of praise: always friendly, helpful, and attentive to every need. The environment is organized, calm, and perfect for letting dogs work in the best possible way.
Max has improved tremendously thanks to their support and patience. I recommend this dog training center to anyone looking for competent and passionate staff.
Manuela C.

We've been coming to the Castelverde dog training center for about a year now and can say, without hesitation, that it has become a fundamental point of reference for us and our dogs.

We started by entrusting our Boxer Ziva to the boarding facility and immediately found a reliable, well-organized environment that, above all, pays attention to the needs of each individual furry friend.

We now also bring Bruno, who is undergoing daycare and training, with tangible and visible results.

Francesca and her entire staff stand out for their professionalism, expertise, and great availability. They work with passion and care, establishing a relationship of trust with both the puppies and their owners.

The facility is truly meticulously cared for, clean, organized, and truly designed for the well-being of both the dogs and their owners!

Even though it's not the easiest place for us to get to, the "sacrifice" is more than worth it for the quality of the service and the peace of mind we feel when leaving our pups.

A well-deserved five stars. Highly recommended.

I've been bringing my puppy Ingrid, an Amstaff, to the Castel Vedere Dog Center for about 5 months now and couldn't be happier with my choice. From the first moment, I found a special environment...surrounded by greenery, well-kept, and relaxing. A place where you truly feel like you can disconnect from the world and breathe in serenity, and this is also evident in the dogs. Francesca, the owner, is an extraordinary person...super professional, competent, but at the same time very sweet and easy-going. You can clearly see how much she loves her job and how much she truly cares about the well-being of each dog. Ingrid is supervised by her in puppy classes, and every meeting is always a positive experience, both for her and for me. Plus, when the opportunity arises, I also leave her in the boarding kennel, and seeing her so happy to go there is the greatest confirmation for me. I trust her blindly, and that's not something you can take for granted. It's an environment where you truly feel the care, passion, and love for dogs. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone who wants the best for their puppy. 🐶🥰
A safe haven for our four-legged friends and for us two-legged friends!

Professionalism, friendliness, skill, and experience. This is Centro Cinofilo Castel Verde. A special thanks to our trainer Francesca.
Greetings from Francesca, Angelo, and Pablo
Thank you so much

Exceptional dog training center. I've seen incredible improvements in my dog's behavior since the first few lessons. The staff is empathetic, patient, and highly competent. If you're looking for the best training for your puppy, you've come to the right place!

I didn't even want to leave my two kittens. I don't even trust leaving them with my mother. I brought them to Francesca and they are two cowards as soon as they got out of the carrier they let themselves be taken without hesitation. She has a gift and is a special person. The guys who work there are wonderful. Beyond the professionalism there is love and passion and you can feel it!

A wonderful place where love for animals comes first.
Incredible professionalism and love from Francesca and the entire staff.
The perfect place to train, love, and entertain your puppy.
Everything was perfect.
Highly recommended.

An excellent experience at this dog training center. From the very first moment, you could feel the professionalism of Francesca and the entire staff: helpful, competent, and attentive to the needs of each dog.
My dog's progress was evident after just a few lessons, both in terms of obedience and safety.
The facility is well-organized, clean, and located in a space suitable for outdoor activities.
I highly recommend this center to anyone who wants to improve their relationship with their dog and rely on dedicated and passionate professionals.
Professional and definitely very knowledgeable! Highly recommended.

What can I say!!! My experience at the Castelverde dog training center has been totally positive!!! I adopted a mixed-breed puppy a month and a half ago and I'm starting to get to know him and he's learning to follow my commands! Thanks to Sara who, in addition to being competent, is always present even outside of the weekly physical appointment. All the other staff is also helpful and very kind!! Every week he improves and becomes more and more balanced... The place physically is well-kept and free of any danger! There are bowls for the dogs to drink and very large spaces. Another important thing is that they have daycare and dog boarding which is very convenient and it's a service I will definitely try. Thank you so much because it shows that the well-being of the puppy and his education are the first things Sara and everyone else care about!!! I absolutely recommend it!

Very sweet people, friendly both with us and with the dogs! There's a wonderful thing I really like: during your dog's extended stay, they send you videos to show you how they are doing. Highly appreciated! I recommend it!!

The absolute best center in the entire area. They offer excellent trainers for a variety of needs, a wonderful cattery, and they also offer various sports, something not everyone in the area is as well equipped for. I recommend it to everyone. It's not just talk, it's real.
Professionalism, competence, large green spaces, friendly and helpful trainers

I couldn't have made a better choice for my two puppies!
We embarked on this journey with some doubts and high expectations, but thanks to Sara's professionalism, patience, and above all, passion, everything was much simpler and more beautiful.
Sara was able to immediately create a bond with my two puppies, Teddy and Sky, understanding their needs and helping me better understand their language. Each lesson was helpful, clear, and above all, tailor-made for us.
I've seen tangible improvements in a short time, but the most important thing is that I now have the right tools to better manage them and strengthen our relationship every day.
I recommend this dog training center to anyone who truly wants to understand their dog and build a healthy, peaceful, and trusting relationship.
Thank you so much! 🥰🥰
